notes.title: Gamescom 2025
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, Hoomanz fans! 
[/h2][p align="start"]In case you missed it, Hoomanz! was at Gamescom 2025 and it was even better than we imagined. All of [b]you were awesome[/b] and gave us full confidence going into our [b]full launch of [i]Hoomanz![/i] aimed at the end of October THIS YEAR.[/b][/p][p align="start"]A big thank you to everyone, but especially [b]YOU[/b]!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145176/8c31031c68ef8af7720ec24b41cc900f55999e52.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] the person who came again after visiting us last year in 2024; with that sparkle in your eyes eager to play the game again.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] the person who asked our team to sign their memory book; with heartfelt messages.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] the person who asked our team to sign your Hoomanz tshirt you won at the booth; and coming back every day for a good laugh.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] the person[b] [/b]who won our first controller giveaway back in Xmas 2024 and just stayed to vibe with us; ending in a fun long interview on camera.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] the person who kept coming back everyday to play even though the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156450/Hoomanz/"]demo was already live on Steam[/url]; you’re a true champ.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] the person who took their time to color in the design for the [url="https://www.hoomanz.game/#shoo-skin-contest"]Shoo Skin Art Contest[/url]; fiddling with every little detail to make it perfect. [i](Yes, we used it as the main attractor since then)[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] all of you who joined our [url="https://discord.com/invite/hNx27YCKUD"]Discord[/url] and made it an even more vibrant community; it’s truly amazing getting to talk to you more on there and vibing together.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] all of you who made us feel proud of [i]Hoomanz![/i] and the journey that took us here; we feel the positive energy surging through the team.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You,[/b] all of you who said they will scream and shout about [i]Hoomanz![/i] to everyone they know and help it become a success![/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]You[/b]… [b]EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU[/b]. Thank you. (づ｡◕‿‿◕｡)づ
[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145176/95cb8ca9fbe888d9878e720174581b2c36b8f3fb.png"][/img][/h2][p][/p][h2]Gamescom in numbers:[/h2][list][*][p][b]879[/b] of you played our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156450/Hoomanz/"][i]Hoomanz![/i][/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156450/Hoomanz/"] demo[/url] at the booth[/p][/*][*][p][b]432[/b] of you [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156450/Hoomanz/"]wishlisted Hoomanz on Steam[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]186[/b] of you filled in our feedback form[/p][/*][*][p][b]168[/b] of you [url="https://www.hoomanz.game/subscribe"]subscribed to our Newsletter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]165[/b] of you joined our vibrant [url="https://discord.gg/hNx27YCKUD"]Discord server[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]83[/b] of you [url="https://www.instagram.com/koffeecup.studio/"]followed us on IG[/url] to keep an eye on what we’re cooking[/p][/*][*][p][b]2.1K[/b] of you checked out our [url="https://www.hoomanz.game/"][i]Hoomanz![/i][/url][url="https://www.hoomanz.game/"] website[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]26.5K[/b] of you viewed our [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@koffeecup.studio"]TikTok[/url]s on our fresh account[/p][/*][*][p][b]7[/b] of you won our exclusive [i]Hoomanz![/i] controller[/p][/*][*][p][b]3[/b] t-shirts signed[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][url="https://www.koffeecup.net/blog-article/hoomanz-devlog-5-gamescom-2025"]Check out the full blog post and see our amazing Gamescom aftermovie![/url] 

[/h3][p][/p][h2]What’s next?
[/h2][p]Now we’re in full preparation for Next Fest in mid October with our Hoomanz! Demo, with the full launch planned shortly afterwards for Halloween! So we will see you all again very soon! 



Want to see more?[i] [/i][url="https://www.koffeecup.net/blog-article/hoomanz-devlog-3-gamescom-2024"]Check out our Gamescom 2024 blog post[/url][i], to compare both years.[/i]
[/p]
